latestVersion.changelog:
Invoice Generator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a comprehensive API for generating, downloading, and emailing invoices with support for GST/IGST and multi-currency.
- Enables customization of invoices with company, customer, line items, tax calculations, payment terms, and professional formatting.
- Supports Indian GST/IGST compliance and direct email delivery via SMTP integration.
- Offers endpoints to generate, download (PDF), and send invoices by email.
- Includes free and paid pricing tiers for various business needs.
